_units: USD per million tokens — current Anthropic list price (pay-as-you-go API value).
_note: Family prices: Fable 5 (claude-fable-5 / claude-mythos-5) is 10/50. Opus 4.6+ and Opus 5 are 5/25 (the retired 4.0/4.1 was 15/75). Sonnet is 2/10: the Claude Sonnet 5 introductory price (since 2026-06-30) became the standard price, the increase to 3/15 scheduled for 2026-09-01 was cancelled. Haiku 4.5 is 1/5. A model whose list price differs from its family's is priced through model_overrides (see _model_overrides): Sonnet 4.6 and earlier Sonnets are no longer under-billed at 2/10, and Fable 5.1 / Mythos 5.1 cache reads are no longer over-billed 4x. Source: platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing, re-read 2026-09-23. cache_read = input x cache_read_multiplier. Cache writes are billed per TTL tier: input x cache_write_multiplier (5-minute) or input x cache_write_multiplier_1h (1-hour). The tier is not assumed: the split is read per session from usage.cache_creation.ephemeral_1h_input_tokens / ephemeral_5m_input_tokens. After editing prices, run `scripts/recompute.sh --with-cost` to re-derive cost_usd for all raw-token rows (plain `recompute.sh` re-derives CO2 only), without needing the (purged) JSONL.
_model_overrides: Per-model prices for ids whose list price differs from their family's. A key matches the model id exactly, or as a prefix followed only by a dated snapshot suffix -YYYYMMDD (claude-opus-5-5 matches claude-opus-5-5-20260922, never claude-opus-5-50); a trailing context marker like [1m] is ignored; the longest matching key wins. Each override may set input, output, cache_write_multiplier, cache_write_multiplier_1h and cache_read_multiplier; anything it leaves out falls back to the family price and the global multipliers. Emission factors stay per family (factors.json): a price is not an energy measurement. Values from platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing, 2026-09-23: Opus 5.5 4/20 with cache reads at 0.20 (0.05x); Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1 10/50 with cache reads at 0.25 (0.025x); Sonnet 4.6, 4.5, 4, 3.7 and 3.5 at 3/15. Opus 5 and 4.x, Fable 5, Sonnet 5 and Haiku 4.5 bill at their family price and need no override.
_cache_write_multipliers: Anthropic bills a cache write at 1.25x input for the 5-minute TTL and 2x input for the 1-hour TTL. The tier is set per cache_control block, so one request can mix both. Claude Code writes at the 1-hour tier: 174,465,500 ephemeral_1h tokens against 0 ephemeral_5m over 24,978 assistant requests (measured 2026-08-24). Rows captured before the split existed carry cache_creation_1h_tokens = 0 and are priced at the 5-minute tier; backfill.sh repairs them while their transcript is still on disk.
_eur_per_usd_note: ECB euro reference rate 2026-06-22 (1 EUR = 1.1456 USD). Convert USD costs to EUR at display time; do not store EUR amounts. Refresh ~monthly from ECB.
